name: Voxel Face Meshing with Packed Attributes
aliases: Voxel Meshing with Packed Vertex Attributes
definition: A mesh generation technique for voxel terrain where vertex data (position, type, direction) is packed into a single float attribute to reduce buffer overhead, unpacked in the vertex shader, and used to generate quad faces for visible voxel surfaces.
summary: Voxel Face Meshing with Packed Attributes reduces buffer overhead by packing vertex data into a single float per vertex, which the shader unpacks to generate quad faces for voxel terrain.
